Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II + SIG/CAIQ supplemental evidence — Atlas vendor assessment

Hi Rishi,

Atlas Clinical is kicking off a vendor assessment for our patient-data workflows and we need to collect a short package from Redwood to close our security review. We have the usual checklist items but can be pragmatic on redaction. Specifically we need:

- SOC 2 Type II report for the period that covers 2025-11-01 to 2026-10-31 (if available).
- A signed bridge letter confirming no material scope changes since the report period and noting any important changes to auth/logging controls.
- Supplemental artifacts beyond the report:
  - MFA rotation/disablement logs for privileged service accounts (last 12 months)
  - Examples of authn/access logs (log slices) showing successful/failed MFA events and session termination timing (we accept pseudonymization/ID hashing)
  - Most recent access review artifacts for engineering and infra roles (quarterly recertifications)
  - Description of data retention and pseudonymization policy (how long user-identifiable data is held, and how/when it is pseudonymized)
- SIG/CAIQ responses for our risk team (we can start with a subset focused on IAM & Logging)

Would you be able to send an evidence list and an expected delivery timeline? Also clarify whether log slices can be pseudonymized (hashing preferred) and whether production-only artifacts are acceptable (we do not need staging).

Thanks — appreciate a short reply with next steps.

Best,
Maya Patel
Sr. InfoSec Manager, Atlas Clinical

Hi Maya — thanks for the request and the template. We'll own this from Redwood's side. Quick plan and a couple of clarifying Qs: 

Plan (high level):
- We will provide the SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) and a signed bridge letter covering 2025-11-01 to 2026-10-31.
- For supplemental artifacts we'll produce: an MFA rotation summary CSV (service-account-focused), redacted log slices showing MFA successes/failures, the most recent access-review package (Q3 2026), and our SIG/IAM responses subset.
- Expected timeline: SOC2 PDF + bridge letter within 2 business days after internal approvals; log slices and MFA rotation summary within 5 business days once we confirm redaction approach and secure transfer method.

Clarifying questions:
1) Confirm: production-only artifacts are acceptable (no staging needed)?
2) Do you require user IDs to be fully anonymized, or is pseudonymization (SHA256 with per-customer salt) acceptable?
3) For MFA rotation logs — do you want the full event stream (potentially large) or a filtered extract for privileged/service accounts only? We recommend filtered extracts to avoid unnecessary PII.

Neha (security) and Laura (audit evidence) are looped in to help scope extraction and sign the bridge. If we get your answers this afternoon we can commit a delivery date. Also, what secure transfer mechanism do you prefer — SFTP, encrypted Drive link, or a third-party transfer portal?

Cheers,

Hi Rishi — thanks for the quick plan. Answers below: 

1) Production-only is correct. Please exclude any non-prod artifacts.
2) Pseudonymization is fine. We prefer a consistent one-way hash (SHA256) with a per-customer salt. Include a short note describing the salt management approach.
3) Filtered extracts limited to privileged/service accounts are preferred (we do not need a full event stream). Please include a short schema for the extract and a sample row.

Transfer: SFTP is our standard for log slices. I can provide host/credentials once you confirm the file layout and a POA for redaction.

Deliverables we expect: SOC2 PDF, signed bridge letter, log slice (CSV), MFA-rotation-summary (CSV), access-review (PDF), SIG/IAM subset (XLSX or PDF). If you can give us a target delivery date by end of day tomorrow we'll include that in our assessment timeline.

Thanks — Maya
